chunks.text: My name's Marcus. Twenty-four years old. No job. No savings. And as of this morning... no home.
My dad dropped a duffel bag on the porch and said, "Thirty days. Go pro at something... or don't come back."
Go pro. At what? I've got a cracked phone, forty-seven dollars, and a soccer ball I haven't touched since high school.
But I've got thirty days. And this time... you decide what I do.

chunks.title: SOCCER
chunks.text: Option A: I hit the street pitch and try to go pro in soccer.

chunks.title: STREAMING
chunks.text: Option B: I spend my last forty-seven bucks on a used mic and go pro at streaming.
Comment A or B. Whatever wins... that's Day two.
